limitations: Only the penultimate distinct-distance Vietoris–Rips stage is classified. scientific_integrity: The claimed new result is the terminal Euclidean Rips phase diagram for every width, twist, and positive height. The cycle and Möbius-ladder independence-complex homotopy classifications are prior theorems explicitly credited. No unperformed independent audit is asserted.
title: Terminal Vietoris–Rips homotopy phases of twisted double regular polygons
